memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus said: 'Worship the Lord your God, and serve only Him.'

sequence.prompt: What happened in the desert? Put it in order.

items.label: God's Spirit led Jesus to the desert
Forty days with nothing to eat
The tempter asked Him three times
The tempter left, and angels came

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: He can only ask — he cannot make you
With God's own words, every time
They said yes; Jesus said no

application.question: Jesus answered with God's words. What wrong thing sounds like a good idea to you?

options.label: Being unkind to get my way

application.followUp: Being tempted is not the same as doing wrong — Jesus was tempted and He stayed perfect. The tempter can only whisper; he cannot make you do anything. And Jesus said no three times, so you can say it too.
